🇺🇸 US CENTCOM strikes vessel linked to Iranian shadow fleet Following a pause, US Central Command reported the defeat of another ship connected to Iran's shadow fleet. A military aircraft struck the dry cargo vessel M/V Pacific Archer , sailing under the flag of Palau, which attempted to breach the blockade of Iranian ports. The targeting of a dry cargo ship is significant: Washington aims to sustain the blockade in both directions - not only hindering oil exports but also disrupting Iranian imports critical for its industrial sector. @Slavyangrad
